global.title: Auto start/stop defaults
global.description: These values only initialize the entities of a thermostat that has no saved state yet. The detection parameters are then set on the thermostat's entities (level, minimum duration, error threshold).

thermostat.title: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Select a thermostat to cover with a dedicated configuration. Its entities carry the enable state, the stop mode and the detection parameters.

thermostat_options.title: Thermostat settings
thermostat_options.description: These values initialize the thermostat's entities that have no saved state yet. Editing this configuration does not change the detection parameters already set on the entities.

error.not_over_climate: This thermostat is not an over_climate thermostat, so the auto start/stop cannot be applied to it.
error.valve_regulation: This thermostat is regulated by a valve, which the auto start/stop feature does not support.
error.invalid_entity: The selected thermostat no longer exists.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has an auto start/stop configuration.

init.title: Auto start/stop settings
init.description: These values initialize the thermostat's entities that have no saved state yet. The live detection parameters are set on the entities (level, minimum duration, error threshold), without a reload.

entity_id_conflict.message: Cannot reuse {entity_id}: it is already owned by another entity. Resolve the conflict and reload this configuration.

invalid_auto_start_stop_bound.message: Value refused for {entity_id}: {value} is outside the allowed bounds ({min} to {max}).

level_already_named.message: The level is already '{level}': selecting 'Custom' would change nothing. Edit a duration or threshold first.

missing_configuration.message: The auto start/stop configuration no longer exists.
